Sentence (English): Got this to replace our old 16year old Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Love Bosch Dishwashers! ] || ---------------- || Got this to replace our old 16year old Bosch dishwasher. This new one does the same great job of getting dishes clean; much longer cycle than the old one (because I use the Sanitize cycle, which I used on the old Bosch too), but I can deal with that (like to run the dishwasher after dinner and unload before I go to bed). Still getting used to the silverware rack! I think it was easier to just put silverware in the silverware basket rather than individually place each piece of silverware in the silverware rack, but again I'm adjusting. Fold up rack on the left side of the bottom rack a little "funky" - I put my saucer and bread plates there- the fold up rack doesn't like to stay up (doesn't click into place to hold it upright) - minor complaint. I expected the dishwasher to be quiet - and it is! Sometimes I wonder if it's really running, but of course it is. This model has the controls/display on the front of the dishwasher, which I wanted. Kind of liked the cycle minutes count down on the old dishwasher, but again, will adjust! It would be helpful if the "clean" light that illuminates when the dishwasher is done was a different color, like maybe green, to distinguish it from the other cycle status lights, but that's likely a personal preference since i usually empty the dishwasher before I go to bed (the lights all shut off when the dishwasher is done; guess I'm just waiting so I can empty the dishwasher). Overall, despite these minor differences from my old Bosch, I am very pleased with the performance of this dishwasher! I hope it lasts 16yrs like my old one!

Sentence (English): What I really like: the ability to have the door automaticaly open at end of drying cycle, the auto cycle that evauates water clarity to determine when cleaning is done, drying cycle is good.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || What I really like: the ability to have the door automaticaly open at end of drying cycle, the auto cycle that evauates water clarity to determine when cleaning is done, drying cycle is good. A surprise- the third tray- I did not think much of the third tray but have come to like it alot. Wife has silicon pads for cookie trays that were always hard for me to clean, the third rack is wonderful for these. Alos I like how it handles the silverware. Another feature I wanted this time was a removable filter. In the past I thought it was not needed as the units I had were self cleaning with grinders to remove gunk. But over time when I had problems with my old dishwashers and I disassembled them to work on them, I found gross amount of gunk in the units. I decided I would rather have a filter system to capture this gunk and allow me ot clean it up periodically rather that blindly hoping the dishwasher is keeping itself clean (the old ones were not). What I am not so keen on: the trays are lightwight and you need to pull them out by grabbing the center or the tray racks a bit, same with the door easy to flex if you grab it off center. What I did not like: when installing the unit, all the connections are to the rear of the unit so they had to be made up first, and then the unit pushed in. I found this difficult as it seemed I was working blind as could not see anything as the front was blocked off. The front framework seems mostly plastic and I had a hard time getting it into place and centered without the need to pry on some plastic which deformed easily. The plastic height adjustment wheels should be metal. Compared to the other 4 or 5 dishwashers I have installed in my house (ya I am old), I thought this was the worse design for installing. Since the unit has a electrical plug instead of hard wired in, I had to by an adapter kit, which worked fine but seemed it should have been provided. Upon start up, my unit gives a low noise that sounds like a truck pulling into the driveway. Definately louder that other dishwashers I have had. After initial start up the noise level is ok, and I am getting used to the start up noise. OK, I gave the good and the bad. Overall I am liking the dishwasher features more and more. I have even use the online app which provides intesting information. The problems I had at installation are fading in importance and if you have a professional install it, these concerns will be taken care of. With gaining familiarity with using the dishwasher I am getting used to dealing with the not so keen items I mentioned and am like the unit more and more. Summary: I recommend this dishwasher as a good unit.

Sentence (English): After my 16 year old dishwasher gave up the fight, I was happy to find my Bosch at a great price.
Comments (English): [ MY NEW BOSCH DISHWASHER! ] || ---------------- || After my 16 year old dishwasher gave up the fight, I was happy to find my Bosch at a great price. At first, I was a little intimidated by the "technology". I mean, a dishwasher is a dishwasher, right? You prep your dishes [basically, you WASH your dishes], load them, add soap, and turn it on. When the cycle is done, you empty the dishwasher (which requires drying almost everything in the process). So, when I read that all I need to do is scrape my dishes - NO RINSING NEEDED - I laughed. Still, I decided to give it a try. OH MY! CLEAN, SPARKLING, SHINING dishes, including those with dried on sauces from the previous day! and my plastic containers and lids were cleaner than ever before! (This is on the basic 1 hour wash setting) Did I mention that I DIDN'T NEED TO DRY ANYTHING? Now, that typed, I must be honest and say I wish I'd read more reviews about the loading issues with this model - specifically how close together and slanted the tines are. Other than plates, I'm unable to put anything else on the bottom rack unless I put it between the rows of tines. It's really a waste of space. Overall, I'm more than satisfied with the cleaning - and programming - capabilities of my dishwasher!

Where it struggles is the design of the bottom rack. The layout isn't intuitive, and placing dishes—especially larger glasses and travel mugs, serving pieces, or oddly shaped cookware—often feels like playing Tetris. The prongs and spacing don't naturally guide you into a clean, organized configuration, which can make loading more frustrating than it should be. Nevertheless, Bosch is still a standout choice. I just wish the bottom rack were as thoughtfully engineered as the cleaning system itself.

Sentence (English): My KitchenAid Dishwasher water pump broke for the 2nd time in 4 years.
Comments (English): [ No spots! ] || ---------------- || My KitchenAid Dishwasher water pump broke for the 2nd time in 4 years. I was considering buying a new pump again, but I figured it'd last only a few years again so I decided to dump KitchenAid. I hate washing dishes by hand so with little research, I bought this Bosch 300 series and luckily it was on sale. I hadn't even bothered to read up about all of its features because I was in such a rush to replace the old dishwasher. There are some really cool features. I didn't even realize it has a built-in water softener but it's my favorite feature! My L.A. tap water is about 380ppm and I don't have a whole house water softener. I bought a bag of dishwasher salt, filled the container, and that's it. After 3 weeks of use, there are no hard water stains on my dishes or inside the dishwasher. It really works. Another cool feature is that an indicator lights up on the panel when either the drying agent or the salt is low and needs to be refilled. I think my KitchenAid was quieter, but this Bosch is still quiet and shouldn't disturb you. The top rack can hold a lot of utensils. I installed the Bosch app and it's actually pretty useful. It tells you how much longer till the cycle ends. Tells you if you're low on drying aid or salt. It allows you to enter your water hardness so it can decide how much water softening is needed. It also tells you the energy and water consumption of all of your cycles. The only potential negative are the buttons on the dishwasher. They don't click when you press them; they're kind of squishy. I just hope they don't fail over time. Oh, and I guess the most important thing. Do they clean and dry well? Yes. They clean very well. The dishes come out dry. There's a little leftover water here and there on a random plate or cup, but nothing to complain about.

Sentence (English): We replaced our old model a year ago when the control circuit board died.
Comments (English): [ Good with room for improvements ] || ---------------- || We replaced our old model a year ago when the control circuit board died. There is much I like about this new model. First, it performs great, and it's quiet. Some of the smart features are welcome, especially the self monitoring ones: salt level and machine cleaning needed. The CrystalDry drying mechanism works well and unit keeps heat in -- dishes almost always dry. Some smart features, like remote start, I never use. Others are harder to use than my previous Bosch model. Their HomeConnect phone app is confusing and harder to use than the physical controls on the old model -- needs more thought to make it easier to understand and as convenient as the buttons on older models. Also, when using the delayed start feature, the phone has to stay within range and linked to the machine; if phone loooses connection with the washer, the next morning the dishes aren't washed. The customizable schedule SmartStart is a great idea -- it just needs to work without requiring the phone stay within range of the machine. Because we have hard water, I needed this topline model to get the salt conditioner feature. The salt usage is adjustable through the phone app; the challenge is figuring out what level is needed, in part due to which detergent you're using as well as the degree of hardness of water--understanding water hardness and how to convert between hardess measurement standards is a separate challenge. The ballbearing wheels make the drawers slide smoothly. The new flatware baskets are lighter than ones in older model and not as deep, resulting in the utensils leaning every which way -- I kept the old basket to use in the new model and it's still in good shape. And, I love the staimless steel tub for durability and cleanability.

Sentence (English): I was skeptical even though reviews consistently rated the SHP9PCM5N high for cleaning ability, but the difference between how clean my dishes get now compared to all prior dishwashers I've owned or used is significant.
Comments (English): [ Impressed it cleans much better than prior d/w ] || ---------------- || I was skeptical even though reviews consistently rated the SHP9PCM5N high for cleaning ability, but the difference between how clean my dishes get now compared to all prior dishwashers I've owned or used is significant. I used to have to pre-rinse, now I choose to scrape hard items into trash (including small, such as açaí berry particles) to protect life of plumbing, but otherwise I don't need to pre-rinse like I used to do in past, saving overall water use (and time). It is very quiet like my prior machine (a Maytag from back before it was merged with Whirlpool), which I had also selected for quiet operation. I discovered my water tested as quite hard, so the water softener salt feature is useful. A couple of annoyances do exist though: 1) the rinse aid dispenser drips or leaks some rinse aid after each time I fill it. Wish it were a bit better seal, and wider opening where you fill it would help. I bought a funnel to compensate. 2) I wish some of the tines did not tilt. All the tines tilt. Some dishes are a struggle to place in the angled tines. And the width of the space for glasses between the tilted tines doesn't really accommodate my wider cups and coffee mugs, making it more challenging and less space efficient to load than prior machines. But the usefulness of the top (3rd) rack is better than anticipated, which adds capacity. I find the 3rd rack is not just for silverware, but useful for flat lids, small cookie sheets and even some smaller plates provided they are thin and shaped such that water doesn't pool on top when layed flat. Drying is excellent with the crystal system. Except for the two shortcomings mentioned it is a genuine upgrade from past dishwashers I've owned.

Sentence (English): I purchased a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal dimensions. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, and the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem resulted in permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) from a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Sentence (English): However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment.
Comments (English): I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal dimensions. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, and the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem resulted in permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) from a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Comments (English): [ The best dishwasher ever! ] || ---------------- || I recently bought my Bosch dishwasher and it is, honestly, the best dishwasher I have ever owned! Sentence (English): When I moved, I sold my old Samsung 6-person dishwasher on Carrot and purchased a new Samsung BESPOKE AI 12-person built-in dishwasher (DW80F71Y1UEWS).
Comments (English): [ When buying a dishwasher, you should buy one with a large capacity. ] || ---------------- || When I moved, I sold my old Samsung 6-person dishwasher on Carrot and purchased a new Samsung BESPOKE AI 12-person built-in dishwasher (DW80F71Y1UEWS). My previous 6-person dishwasher was always underpowered, and having to wash pots and pans separately by hand was inconvenient. This time, I feel more spacious, perhaps because of the larger capacity. The large size allows me to load pots, pans, and even a steamer all at once, which is incredibly convenient. With my previous model, the dishwasher wouldn't close if I overloaded it, making it a hassle to reposition. This model has a spacious interior and adjustable trays, so I can easily adjust the height to fit pots and pans. This has significantly reduced the stress of washing up after meals. Plus, the BESPOKE design blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. I chose Essential White, which has a subtle, non-glossy texture, giving it a clean and luxurious feel. Because it's built-in, the exterior is so sleek that first-time users might not even notice it. The installer was very friendly and completed the installation neatly. I'm overall satisfied with the cleaning performance. It was able to clean greasy pots, glasses, and dishes thoroughly. However, there was a slight residue of foam during initial use, but the user manual suggests reducing the detergent or adjusting the rinse cycle to resolve this issue. Indeed, after two or three uses, the foam residue was almost completely gone. The AI cleaning function is also quite useful. It automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cleaning time, eliminating the need to worry about cycle selections. It's also energy-efficient. It's also quiet during the wash cycle, so it's not annoying even when running at night. Another plus was the complimentary five-month supply of dishwasher detergent. This reduced the initial cost and allowed me to use it right away. Overall, the Samsung BESPOKE AI 12-person dishwasher is a satisfying product in terms of capacity, cleaning power, design, and ease of use. Sentence (English): I purchased a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

LG설치기사님은 고객에게 주의사항을 설명을 안했다는 것에 대한 잘못을 인정하지 않았고, 하수구에 역류된물이 없다고 주변에 다른 아파트에서도 역류가 많이 생긴다고 하는것을 알고 있었지만 저희에게는 하수구 역류에 의한 주의사항을 이야기해주지 않음, 실제로 설치 Guide에 하수구 역류에 관한 주의사항 고지를 사항이 있는지 없는지 확인이 필요 5. LG고객센터 1:1문의에 글을 남겼지만 고객센터에서도 물류팀에게 책임 전가 1:1문의도 유선상으로 완료되었고 물류팀하고 이야기하라고 함.6. 물류팀에서는 현장을 오셔서 확인하였지만 팔이 안으로 굽는다고 설치에는 문제가 없었으므로 강화마루 수리비는 책임질 수 없다고 함.7. 원인제공은 고객이 했으니 하수구 수리비용은 고객이 부담하는게 맞지만, 테스트 미흡 or 테스트 확인 미흡, 하수구 역류가 많이 있는걸 알면서도 개인판단으로 하수구 역류에 대한 주의사항 미고지에 대한 책임이 있다고 고객입장에서 판단합니다. 제 3자 입장에서도 판단 부탁드립니다.

Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Comments (English): [ I bought a dishwasher. Performance, ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. I am very satisfied with its excellent performance, design, and usability. Performance: It cleans dishes much more squeakily than washing them manually. Design: The beige color blends seamlessly with any decor, making it a perfect fit. Usability: I am very satisfied with the ease of use, time adjustments, and internal size. However, I encountered some disappointing issues with the appliance. Issues: 1. A drain backflow problem occurred on the day of installation during the first use. 2. The drain clog was acknowledged as a problem for the customer's home, but the customer was responsible for repairing the drain and replacing the entire sink drain. 3. Despite being aware that many households experience drain backflow after dishwasher installation, the manufacturer failed to provide the customer with proper precautions. While it's difficult to determine whether the testing was inadequate, the customer was clearly aware that a drain backflow would have occurred during the drain test. However, the manufacturer informed the customer that there was no problem. This unforeseen backflow problem caused permanent damage to the kitchen laminate floor (wood) after a single use of the dishwasher. 4. The LG installer did not admit to his mistake in not explaining the precautions to the customer, and although he knew that there was no sewer backflow and that other apartments in the area were experiencing frequent sewer backflows, he did not tell us about the precautions to take due to sewer backflow. We need to check whether the installation guide actually includes a notice about sewer backflow precautions. 5. I left a message in a 1:1 inquiry with the LG customer center, but the customer center also shifted the responsibility to the logistics team. The 1:1 inquiry was completed over the phone and I was told to talk to the logistics team. 6. The logistics team came to the site to check, but they said that since there was no problem with the installation because their arms were bent inward, they could not be held responsible for the cost of repairing the laminate flooring. 7. Since the customer provided the cause, it is right for the customer to pay the sewer repair cost. However, from the customer's perspective, I judge that the customer is responsible for insufficient testing or insufficient test confirmation, and for failing to notify us of the sewer backflow precautions despite knowing that there were frequent sewer backflows based on their personal judgment. Please make your judgment from a third-party perspective as well.

Sentence (English): These days, my immune system is weakened, and I'm more susceptible to minor ailments like enteritis, which has made me more health-conscious.
Comments (English): [ These days, my immune system is weakened and I'm more sensitive to minor illnesses like enteritis, so I've become more interested in sterilization. That's why I started looking into dishwashers that can dry with hot air. I found a few at the store. ] || ---------------- || These days, my immune system is weakened, and I'm more susceptible to minor ailments like enteritis, which has made me more health-conscious. This has led me to look into dishwashers with hot air dryers. After comparing several models and features at the store, I found one at a very good price. They contacted me immediately after ordering and scheduled the installation for the next day. I was worried after reading many reviews about the inconsistent nature of the installers, but they were incredibly diligent and I was grateful. They checked the installation space and, although the space was suitable, they charged me a 50,000 won installation fee due to a slight gap. After checking, they installed the dishwasher right away, and it took about an hour. After installation, they explained the instructions and features in an easy-to-understand manner and answered any questions I had. Since detergent wasn't available that day, I washed the dishes and just ran the hot air dryer. Wow, the dishes were so sterilized and delicious. The next day, detergent was available, so I ran the few dishes I had. After dinner, I forgot about them for two hours, and a notification popped up saying they were done. When they finished, I checked and they were clean, hot, and dried perfectly, with no water stains. I regretted having hesitated to buy a dishwasher for so long. ^^ Now, I'm happy to think about clean dishes and a relaxed evening. I'm writing down some things I found out because I was curious. I hope this will be helpful to those who are new to using dishwashers like me. - Salt and rinse are not required, so just add detergent and try it out. If necessary, buy it. - Simply pre-wash sauces and food scraps before running it. They say food scraps cause a strong smell. - You can use additional features in the LG ThinkQ app. Please update the app regularly. #LGDishwasher #DUE6BGL1E #KitchenEssentials

Sentence (English): I have had many brands of dishwasher and this is my first Bosch product.
Comments (English): [ My dishes have never been so clean ] || ---------------- || I have had many brands of dishwasher and this is my first Bosch product. I chose it solely based off of people talking about the quality of Bosch. I used to just go with all marching appliances and this is my first time breaking away from that to go to a reliable product. I can honestly say that this dishwasher is so quiet, you don't even know it's running and when it's connected to the app, it notifies me of what it's doing, time left and alerts when the cycle is complete. The only noise I ever hear from this unit are the sweet gentle tones AKA "music to my ears" letting me know my dishes are clean and all the hard work it took care of. My dishes are extremely clean and there is no smell in the tub. I now want to replace all of my appliances with Bosch products. If you are considering this product, I highly recommend. It's honestly a no brainer!

Sentence (English): If you're like me and have had your old dishwasher for many years, the new Bosch 800 series will come as something of a shock.
Comments (English): [ Steep Learning Curve ] || ---------------- || If you're like me and have had your old dishwasher for many years, the new Bosch 800 series will come as something of a shock. Pluses: It gets the dishes really clean. It really does take only a scraping, no rinsing. It's really quiet. Minuses: It takes forever to do that: 2 hrs. 47 minutes vs. 85 minutes with my old unit. It took at least three videos before I found one that had adequate tips on how to load serving dishes. The arrangement of the racks and tines mean I can wash fewer dishes/bowls, etc.--and way fewer glasses--per load than I could in my old two-rack dishwasher. I'm glad I saved the silverware basket from my old dishwasher. It's sturdier by far than the Bosch. Why don't I use the top rack for most flatware? Because it's on the other side of the kitchen from my silverware drawer and the rack's not removable--and moving where I store my flatware makes no sense for where I use it. In 24 years, I never had to clean my old dishwasher and it had no filter to wash. I finally found a video to show me how to remove the upper spray arm for cleaning, but I've yet to figure out how to remove the lower one. In spite of regular cleaning of the filter, the dishwasher often smells funky between running. Perhaps because there's only one of me, so I only run it every four to five days, but that was not a problem for 24 years with my Maytag. Would I buy it again? Don't know, but I hope I don't have to face that problem for a long, long time.

Sentence (English): I bought the Bosch 800 series 2 months ago when my previous dishwasher heated drying stopped working and also just wasn't doing a good job cleaning my dishes.
Comments (English): [ 2 months in and working great ] || ---------------- || I bought the Bosch 800 series 2 months ago when my previous dishwasher heated drying stopped working and also just wasn't doing a good job cleaning my dishes. I chose Bosch because every review I read was favorable and the research I did shows they come out at or near the top in reliability and low service calls from every appliance dealer/service center I found. The Pros: While it was more than I had planned to spend, so far I am very happy with the dishwasher. I was skeptical when people said you didn't need to soak cookware with dried/stuck on food as my other dishwasher would never get it clean. But this Bosch blew me away when every casarole dish, cooking untencil and piece of silverware comes out spotless. With the crystal dry feature, everything item in the dishwasher comes out bone dry. I really was stunned by the performance of just how well it cleans. To add to the performance, this thing is quiet. Now, that really doesn't mean much coming from me since I'm old and my hearing is shot already. So, to get a better sense of how quiet it was, I ran the dishwasher and had my granddaughter listen for it from about 15 feet away and she said she could only barely hear it. We have an open home design so the kitchen and living room flow into each other, so not hearing the dishwasher while watching TV or talking with friends/family is very pleasant. I was unsure of the usefullness of the 3rd rack but now I'm completely sold on the idea. I'm used to using a basket for the silverware and while this does come with one, we don't use it at all. The upper rack works great and the silverware comes out shinning and way cleaner than my previous dishwasher. The Cons: I really only found 3 drawbacks. The first is that there is no display on the front to indicated time remaining of the cycle. It's a lot of money to not have a simple LED on the front to indicate time left on the cycle. While there isn't an LED dispaly, there is a simple little white light on front that lets you know when it is running. I would love to see Bosch utilize this a little more and make it color changing to indicate the cycle. For example, red is running, amber is rinsing, green is drying an white is completed. This won't tell you the time remaining but it at least gives you an idea of where it's at in the cycle. The most annoying thing is having to connect to cloud to configure the dishwasher, get extra features or determine time remaining on cycle. I will never be in a position where I'm away from the home and want to start the dishwasher so it's silly to make it cloud connected. I need to be home to load it, so why load it, leave the house and then start it with the app? It makes no sense. I do like that they make the app work with Google Home but it's just annoying to need to opt into a cloud connection to get extra features. I get why Bosch wants that because they want data on how their products are being used but it's still silly to connect to cloud. A simple local app would be better for this type of stuff. Overall, I really do love the diswasher and would give it 5 stars were in not for these minor annoyances of cloud connection. Note, cloud is NOT required to use the dishwasher, it's only needed if you want a little extra bells/whistles. I will like buy a Bosch for my rental house as well given how well this one works.

Sentence (English): As second time Bosch dishwasher owners my wife and I were grateful Bosch has maintained its repurtation for whisper quiet machines.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || As second time Bosch dishwasher owners my wife and I were grateful Bosch has maintained its repurtation for whisper quiet machines. With an open floor plan, operating the machine any time of the day or night disturbs absolutely nothing or no one. The controls on this unit, located along the top of the door, also appear to designed - unlike our last Bosch - in such a way that they won't get dirty looking and resist every attempt at getting them clean. That's the good stuff. However, from about 8 or so years ago when we bought our last Bosch, the build quality and what the machine offers do not measure up. Our new machine's door feels notably flimsy by comparison, and the plastic handle insert on the front feels like it might pop off or break (on our old machine, it actually cracked at the top from normal use). The new machine also came with a little bitty utensil basket (our last machine had a full-size silverware basket). Given how fast the full-sized basket fills up with a normal load of dishes, the smaller version is overflowing, and tightly packing the silver hampers cleaning. We know the top rack can be used for additional silverware, but that is invoncenient and takes up room that we prefer to use for spatulas, large spoons, and other larger, flat items. Finally, for some reason the 500 Series does not seem to clean as well as our last model, failing to remove things from the tines of forks, the backs of tablespoons, and even plates, though we leave a space between dinnerware each time we use it. Not sure what the issue is, but we are more careful to pre-clean now. So - still quiet as can be (our top priority). And, though it still cleans okay, it does not seem to clean as well as the first Bosch we purchased and it does not feel nearly as solidly built. And, skimping on the silverware basket - really, guys? For the price point, that's just wrong.

Sentence (English): Family and friends have long touted Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Finally bought a Bosch ] || ---------------- || Family and friends have long touted Bosch. After our 9-year-old dishwasher went out several months ago, we purchased an 800 series Bosch Dishwasher. There are a lot of things to like about this machine and one large fault in our opinion. First the good. This machine's organization and capacity are incredible. We run out of dishes and silverware long before it it filled. Its ability to clean dishes is superb and it's as quiet as a mouse. The fact that it dries everything without a heating element is awesome. Our one negitive almost seems insignificant, but for us it is not. This drawback is, that in order to use the delayed start ( a feature that we use to use daily), you are forced to use the Bosch app. It's not that we are technically inept, quite the opposite. We don't care to be compelled to use applications that add little value to us and compromise our privacy at some level.

The rest paled by comparison.Overall, I'm very pleased, and if I get the same level of reliability I got out of it's predecessor, I'll be thrilled.

After spending $1300 you expect a quality product that will run flawlessly for years and this IS NOT. We can't get this dishwasher to run a month without some error code disrupting the wash cycle. We are completely disappointed with this purchase and feel like we have a problem machine that will need repairs in the future. Based on our experience we can't recommend purchasing. NOTE: When it does run, it's quiet and works nicely but the problem is it doesn't run consistently.

Comments (English): [ Do not waste your money. ] || ---------------- || I did not buy this dishwasher, it came with the house I am renting, and it is awful. Our landlord says the appliance is fairly new. I've only been using it for 3 months, but the dishes are always soaking wet after a cycle, and there's often a film of soap left over. Recently I ran the machine 3 times and still found food on my dishes (and I'm one that tries to rinse off all food before putting dishes in the dishwasher). I use dishwasher pods and about 50% of the time, they haven't dissolved at all after a wash cycle, so I know the dishes aren't actually getting clean. I will be replacing this with a different machine ASAP. Also, there's really not a track for the bottom rack, so every time I pull it out, it comes out sideways and occasionally it gets jammed. Everything is plastic and feels super cheap. I know it's affordable, but if it doesn't hold up, you'll end up replacing it, so I'd spend extra to get a machine that works.

Comments (English): [ Great overall dishwasher and purchase experience ] || ---------------- || We bought this to replace a dying LG dishwasher. After extensive research we settled on the previous version (KDTM604) of this model because of its generally great performance reviews and features. Standout features: - Wash performance and ProDry:not only does it have a fan to dry but the door pops open to dry out EVERYTHING. - Self-cleaning filter, which is basically a macerator like in older dishwashers that didn't have removable filters to clean. - it is QUIET - internal space that accommodates a lot of utensils - Simple UI and intuitive wash cycles. Coming from an LG with overcomplicated wash, dry, temp settings and lack of a dedicated drain button, the KitchenAid control panel is a great feature - general look and design: we love the look of the towel bar and the polish on the stainless steel, the KitchenAid logo is muted and not the old shiny chrome badge. What we miss about the LG dishwasher: adjustability of the tines in both the middle and lower racks. The KA has only one row of tines that can be moved or collapse, but we'll probably get used to that over time

Sentence (English): We bought this to replace a dying LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great overall dishwasher and purchase experience ] || ---------------- || We bought this to replace a dying LG dishwasher. After extensive research we settled on the previous version (KDTM604) of this model because of its generally great performance reviews and features. Our timing led to only this model being available and we absolutely love it. Standout features: - Wash performance and ProDry:not only does it have a fan to dry but the door pops open to dry out EVERYTHING. - Self-cleaning filter, which is basically a macerator like in older dishwashers that didn't have removable filters to clean. - it is QUIET - internal space that accommodates a lot of utensils - Simple UI and intuitive wash cycles. Coming from an LG with overcomplicated wash, dry, temp settings and lack of a dedicated drain button, the KitchenAid control panel is a great feature- general look and design: we love the look of the towel bar and the polish on the stainless steel, the KitchenAid logo is muted and not the old shiny chrome badge. What we miss about the LG dishwasher: adjustability of the tines in both the middle and lower racks. The KA has only one row of tines that can be moved or collapse, but we'll probably get used to that over time

Sentence (English): # Price: I did a lot of research, and I was glad and reassured that the official site, Samsung Mall, was the cheapest (I bought it for around 530,000 won after a card discount). #
Comments (English): # Price: I did a lot of research, and I was glad and reassured that the official site, Samsung Mall, was the cheapest (I bought it for around 530,000 won after a card discount). # Product: I was looking for a 6-person countertop, but there were so many products that it was a bit confusing. I looked at the model advertised as a new release from August 2025, but I couldn't really tell what was different, so I compared them for a long time. In the end, aside from slightly improved energy efficiency, I didn't see any major performance enhancements, but I still went with the latest model. However, after buying it, I realized I should have spent an extra 100,000 won to get the hot air dryer. I never imagined it would dry this poorly; after the cycle, the clothes are soaking wet. They said the door opens automatically to dry, but the advertisement was just for show; in reality, the clothes are drenched in water. Sigh. I used an older model from SK Magic before, and with that one, even running it on standard mode, the door would open at the end and the moisture would just evaporate, leaving the clothes almost dry. I'm baffled as to why Samsung can't come up with that kind of technology. # Delivery Disappointment: Isn't the return of used appliances standard practice? They clearly said they would take care of it. When the delivery driver arrived and I asked him to remove the SK part, he said he couldn't do it and told me to call an SK technician to do it. Huh? Comments (English): # Price: I did a lot of research, and I was glad and reassured that the official site, Samsung Mall, was the cheapest (I bought it for around 530,000 won after a card discount). # Product: I was looking for a 6-person countertop, but there were so many products that it was a bit confusing. I looked at the model advertised as a new release from August 2025, but I couldn't really tell what was different, so I compared them for a long time. What's wrong with Samsung? Is this right?

There are a lot of "I don't" and "I can't" comments from the installer, none of which are communicated before their arrival at your home.Based on this experience, I will think twice before buying Samsung again. It is unfortunate that Samsung would associate themselves with 3rd parties whose level of service is a liability to the Samsung brand but, as the old saying goes, we are the company we keep. I think it's time to start looking elsewhere.

Sentence (English): I bought this after three months of deliberation, but when I came back to write a review, the price went down even further in just one day.
Comments (English): I bought this after three months of deliberation, but when I came back to write a review, the price went down even further in just one day. Sadly, I've already used it. ^^ I was worried it would just take up space and go unused, but I finally made the decision to buy it, and its cleaning power exceeded my expectations! At first, I was worried it would be difficult to install, but the components were neat, and it only took about 20 minutes to install it by following the instructions. It's okay for a woman to install it alone, but it's a bit heavy. The cleaning power is much more powerful than I expected. I soaked the dishes in water to test them, so I pre-washed one and left the other in. Both were cleaned beautifully. There weren't even any water stains! This is why I thought dishwashers were so useful. Thanks to the UV sterilization function, it leaves the dishwasher clean and odor-free after washing. I'm especially satisfied with the fact that I can safely store even hygiene-sensitive items like cups and bottles. The water flow is strong, and the internal rotating nozzle reaches every nook and cranny, so there's almost no residue. It's also quite quiet. It's not noisy even when I turn it on at night, and the operating sound is kind of like ASMR. The capacity is said to be for '3 people', but it's enough for a single person living alone, and even a two-person household. It can handle 3-4 rice bowls, cups, and spoons at once. Plus, the internal shelf structure is practical, so you can put everything from small dishes to pot lids in the space you want. We're a newlywed couple, so it's just right for now, but I think it might be a little too small when the family grows! Still, it's enough for a two-person household. I can turn it on and do other household chores, and it's so convenient. The design is simple and clean, so it doesn't detract from the interior. The transparent window allows you to see the washing process, which is kind of fun. Sentence (English): I bought this after three months of deliberation, but when I came back to write a review, the price dropped even further in just one day.
Comments (English): I bought this after three months of deliberation, but when I came back to write a review, the price dropped even further in just one day. Sadly, I've already used it. ^^. I was worried it would just take up space and go unused, but I finally made the decision to buy it, and its cleaning power exceeded my expectations! At first, I was worried it would be difficult to install, but the components were neat and I followed the instructions, so it only took about 20 minutes. It's easy for a single woman to install, but it's a bit heavy. The cleaning power is much more powerful than I expected. I soaked the dishes in water to test it out. I pre-washed one and left the other in the dishwasher. Both were cleaned flawlessly. There weren't even any water stains! I realized this is why people use dishwashers. Thanks to the UV sterilization function, it leaves dishes clean and odor-free after washing. I'm especially satisfied with the fact that I can safely store even hygiene-sensitive items like cups and bottles. The water flow is strong, and the internal rotating nozzle reaches every nook and cranny, leaving almost no residue. It's also quite quiet. It's not noisy even when running in the evening, and the sound of it running is subtly ASMR-like. While the capacity is listed as "for 3 people," it's more than enough for a single person living alone, and even a two-person household. It handles three or four bowls, cups, and spoons at once. Plus, the internal shelf design is practical, allowing for everything from small dishes to pot lids to fit the space. We're a newlywed couple, so it's adequate for now, but I'm worried it might become a bit too small as our family grows! Still, it's more than enough for a two-person household. I can run it while doing other household chores, and it's incredibly convenient. The design is simple and clean, so it doesn't detract from the interior. The transparent window allows you to see the washing process, which is quite fun. Every time the UV light comes on, I'm amazed at how well it's cleaning, and when it's done, the interior sparkles. The drying function is also great, so even when I take it out and put it away, there's barely any moisture left. Overall, the cleaning power and UV sterilization ensure perfect hygiene. It's quiet and has a clean design. It's the perfect size for a single person living with small households. For those who find washing dishes a chore or live in a small studio apartment, this is a must-have. It will definitely improve your quality of life.

Sentence (English): My old dishwashwer was not cleaning things very well.
Comments (English): [ Good, but ] || ---------------- || My old dishwashwer was not cleaning things very well. In addition, having the silverware on the door led to about 20% of the silverware needing to be washed by hand. The Bosch Series 300 has a top silverware drawer and now, almost all my silverware comes out clean. Using eco-friendly, non-pod soap leads to about 10% of the silverware needing to be washed by hand (it's ususally peanut butter knives). Everthing else comes out clean. For me, the big drawback is that the racks are not set up for deep soup bowls. It takes a lot of space to put them flat, face down. My old dishwasher was better at this. I have not taken advantage of the WiFi features and found the control panel a little confusing to operate. I just use auto. I would like to set it up so that it doesn't use heated drying to save on energy.

The large capacity for 14 people means I can handle a day's worth of dishes in one go. It even holds large cooking utensils like pots and pans, significantly reducing the stress of dishwashing. The automatic door opening feature also helps keep the dishwasher hygienic by discharging heat from the inside. Overall, I was satisfied with every aspect, from installation to design and performance. Sentence (English): #MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person Trial Review: Reason for Purchase I was fortunate enough to test out the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person as a Coupang trial member.
Comments (English): #MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person Trial Review: Reason for Purchase I was fortunate enough to test out the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person as a Coupang trial member. Washing dishes just piles up and takes a lot of time, and these days, kitchens are tight, making it difficult to fit a full-size dishwasher. I was looking for a small, yet efficient dishwasher. The description saying it's suitable for 1-3 person households or newlyweds immediately piqued my interest. The no-punch installation option was also appealing. The product details page clearly stated "3-person mini size" and detailed specifications, including capacity and water consumption, gave me confidence. Product Features: No-punch installation: It can be installed in a standard sink without any additional pipes or drilling, making it ideal for households with limited space. Compact size for 3-person use: At approximately 435,420,430 mm in external dimensions and approximately 10.5 kg in weight, it's a comfortable size. Water-Energy Efficiency: Power consumption is 850W and water usage is up to approximately 5.5L, which means less water consumption compared to hand washing. Various Washing Modes and Drying Functions: User reviews cite the ability to choose from a variety of modes, including Normal, Powerful, and Economy, and the complete drying process means you don't have to worry about dishes being left wet when you remove them. Clean Design & Ideal for 1-3 Person Households: Easy to install in small kitchens and ideal for 1-3 person households. User Reviews: After installing and using the dishwasher, it exceeded my expectations. I first put in a few dishes and ran it, and I was surprised to see that even greasy plates and cups came out clean and free of residue. It wasn't as noisy as I thought, so I could leave it on in the living room at night without any problems. Water consumption is significantly lower than when washing dishes by hand, and the time savings are also satisfying. Since getting the dishwasher, I've definitely reduced the stress of washing dishes in the kitchen. The most satisfying thing is being able to immediately clean up the dishes that pile up after dinner, and it also makes putting off the dishes less stressful. In conclusion, the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, which I used as a member of the trial group, is an efficient dishwasher that can be used even in small spaces. It's especially well-suited for households of one to three people who find hand-washing time burdensome or have limited kitchen space for a full-size dishwasher. Of course, it's not always possible to expect enough capacity to load all your dishes and utensils at once, and if you have a lot of large utensils, you may need to wash some by hand. However, if you mainly use plates, cups, and spoons, it's very satisfying. If you're looking to reduce the time, effort, and water consumption of dishwashing, I highly recommend this product. After using it, I found that the burden of washing dishes was reduced and kitchen cleanup became much easier!

User Reviews: After installing and using the dishwasher, it exceeded my expectations. I first put in a few dishes and ran it, and I was surprised to see that even greasy plates and cups came out clean and free of residue. It wasn't as noisy as I thought, so I could leave it on in the living room at night without any problems. Water consumption is significantly lower than when washing dishes by hand, and the time savings are also satisfying. Since getting the dishwasher, I've definitely reduced the stress of washing dishes in the kitchen. The most satisfying thing is being able to immediately clean up the dishes that pile up after dinner, and it also makes putting off the dishes less stressful. In conclusion, the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, which I used as a member of the trial group, is an efficient dishwasher that can be used even in small spaces. It's especially well-suited for households of one to three people who find hand-washing time burdensome or have limited kitchen space for a full-size dishwasher. Of course, it's not always possible to expect enough capacity to load all your dishes and utensils at once, and if you have a lot of large utensils, you may need to wash some by hand. However, if you mainly use plates, cups, and spoons, it's very satisfying. If you're looking to reduce the time, effort, and water consumption of dishwashing, I highly recommend this product. After using it, I found that the burden of washing dishes was reduced and kitchen cleanup became much easier!

Comments (English): [ Worth the price! ] || ---------------- || We were in need to a DW quick because our old one decided to spray water all over the kitchen. Our price range was sub $600. This model had all the features we were looking for (i.e. stainless tub, third rack) and it was in our price range.I installed it, I'm fairly handy and it took about an hour and 15 minutes. The DW comes with a new drain hose and clamp, but no power cable which is pretty typical.We ran an empty "Turbo" cycle to verify operation and check for leaks. Running it empty was VERY loud. like consider taking it back loud. However after loading it and running normal cycles it is still louder than I expected, but not loud enough that is causes problems. We have an open floorplan home with no walls between the DW and the living room. The DW is about 10 ft from where we sit and we can still watch TV like we always did at the same volume level. It does a great job cleaning. Even running on a normal cycle, minimal pre-wash rinse, with a generic pod and no rinse agent it does great. It dries just fine except for plastic dishes, but this is typical as well. All-in-all, at this price point it is definitely a good buy.
